items.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Nick Fatool was one who was comfortable in either a studio setting or a swing band or a big band or a lot of Dixieland bands with Matty Matlock

ctx.x: Who else was influencing you when you were developing on the drums?

Nick Fatool was one who was comfortable in either a studio setting or a swing band or a big band or a lot of Dixieland bands with Matty Matlock, Eddie Miller, Dick Cathcart, the people who played in Southern California, such on the soundtrack of “Pete Kelly’s Blues” and Matty Matlock’s “Paducah Patrol,” and the Rampart Street Paraders and I think Nick Fatool, if you took a survey of musicians, maybe twenty musicians like the ones here this weekend and said who’s your favorite drummer, probably eighteen of them…
